newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products hold, except for stronger gas oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products hold, except for stronger gas oil.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady except for rising gas oil.
Gasoline trade was thin with volatile NYMEX futures keeping prospective U.S. arbitrage buyers at bay.
Naphtha trade was dull with poor petrochemical and reforming demand. Firmer crude held prices notionally steady.
Gas oil soared $8.25 a tonne to $232 on continuing frigid weather. Barges were firmer due to ice blockages in waterways.
High sulphur barges gained up to $4 a tonne getting support from increased bunker demand, the cold weather and firmer crude.
